The separate succession frame is governed by Xiaowu installing Huang’s brother Chong as Miao’s heir; 為奴所害，子惠立 makes Hui Chong’s son and successor. Existing p242 already owns personal 惠/Hui, royal-family-member, male and succession facts plus the p241 father edge. Therefore s0410 cannot support p214’s name/ruler/sex assertions, and its real English Hui occurrence must move intact to p242. I endorse this exact structural operation /claims/664/4/2 without deleting any real occurrence or inventing a person.
